Ava (Partnerships): Quick planning thread \/ we need a one-page onboarding checklist for partners uploading compliance bundles to the marketplace (SOC/pen/qns). Keep it partner-friendly.
Ravi (Security): Key rules: always redact direct identifiers before upload unless contract requires otherwise. Label any NDA material with `NDA:true`. We keep access partner-only until security review.
Marta (SI): Partners prefer a single file upload. Can we standardize filename + metadata so we can automate routing?
Diego (Ops): Suggest schema: `{vendor}-{artifact_type}-{yyyyMMdd}.zip` and companion `metadata.json`. We support presigned uploads via `https://evidence.redwood.ai/presign`. Default presign TTL=24h for partner uploads, can be lowered for public links.
Priya (Eng): Ingestion steps: virus scan, filename normalization, checksum, optional automated redaction pass for emails/SSNs (needs opt-in per partner). We'll tag artifacts with `requires_manual_qc` when scripts find high-risk patterns.
Ava (Partnerships): Can someone paste the short checklist (2-3 lines) + example presign curl I can send? Marta needs it for partner comms.
Ravi (Security): Checklist (short):
- Remove or mask PII (SSN, full credit card, personal emails). Use redaction tokens e.g., `REDACTED-EMAIL` or `XXX-XX-1234`.
- If logs/attachments cannot be redacted, mark `NDA:true` and contact security for secure delivery.
- Include `artifact-metadata.json` with fields: `vendor`, `artifact_type`, `scan_date`, `owner_email`, `nda` (true/false).
Marta (SI): Perfect. Presign example?
Diego (Ops): Presign example (curl):
```
curl -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PARTNER_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"key":"acme/pen-2024-20240201.zip","contentType":"application/zip","ttl":86400}' \ 
  https://evidence.redwood.ai/presign
```
Diego (Ops): Recommend partners also upload `artifact-metadata.json` next to the bundle. Example metadata: `{"vendor":"ACME","artifact_type":"pen-report","scan_date":"2024-02-01","owner_email":"sec-contact@acme.com","nda":false}`
Priya (Eng): For QA: we need one sample upload per partner before they send real artifacts. That sample can be a synthetic zip with the metadata file. We'll run the pipeline and confirm tags.
Ravi (Security): Retention policy: SOC/pen stored 5 years by default, access logged. If NDA flagged, add `requires_security_acl` and set access to `security+partnerships` only until cleared.
Marta (SI): I'll schedule a dry-run with ACME tomorrow. Please confirm owners: Diego will manage presign, Priya will observe ingestion, Ravi will do redaction QA, Ava will communicate acceptance.
Ava (Partnerships): Confirmed. I'll draft the one-pager and post to partners channel.
Priya (Eng): Small note: automated redaction will catch emails and SSN regexes but won't catch screenshots. Ask partners to remove sensitive images.
Diego (Ops): evidence-bot will post an event when uploads arrive. Partners should reference the thread id in metadata so we can tie events back.
Marta (SI): @evidence-bot please notify when I run the dry-run.
evidence-bot: dry-run upload `acme-sample-20240201.zip` by Marta (SI) via presign, size=1.2MB, sha256=aa11bb22cc33, ts=1707777868
Ava (Partnerships): Thanks everyone \/ next steps: Ill share the checklist + sample metadata and close the loop after the dry-run. Action items: Marta (dry-run by 1707860000), Ravi (QA after dry-run), Diego (verify presign TTL and tags). :white_check_mark:
